# CLI reference: AI agents

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-cli-docs.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Commands and HTTP mappings for AI agent operations from the shared operation registry.

| `ai-agents.admin.settings.get`                | `lightdash-tools ai-agents settings get`    | `GET /api/v1/aiAgents/admin/settings`                                                           |                | Get AI organization settings (admin)                                                      |

| `ai-agents.admin.threads.list`                | `lightdash-tools ai-agents threads`         | `GET /api/v1/aiAgents/admin/threads`                                                            |                | List AI agent threads across the organization with optional filters (admin)               |
| `ai-agents.project.agents.create`             | `lightdash-tools agents create`             | `POST /api/v1/projects/{projectUuid}/aiAgents`                                                  |                | Create a new AI agent in a project                                                        |
| `ai-agents.project.agents.delete`             | `lightdash-tools agents delete`             | `DELETE /api/v1/projects/{projectUuid}/aiAgents/{agentUuid}`                                    |                | Delete an AI agent from a project                                                         |
